name: Bathyal-Brae
description: Grass-plains and basalt shields alternate across the habitable belt, stitched together by magnetic pole anomalies. Farther poleward, past an orbital debris ring, the silence feels older than the soil.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
There is money in water here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
